svg.metadata: {"asset_id":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long-epaulet-plain","name":"Women's Class B blue long-sleeve blouse plain epaulet straps (overlay, registered to garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long; no grade)","size_in":{"w":24.5174,"h":36.3441},"units":"1 user unit = 0.01 in","viewBox":[0,0,2451.74,3634.41],"size_source":"estimated","size_basis":"The garment epaulet strap landmark polygons (epaulet_right / epaulet_left of garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long, the edge-on band 0.46 in thick of a 1.0 in strap, LIVE10-ART 2, Fig 4.8): the band itself in the shirt colour with the shirt's line tones, topstitching and a button. The regulation gives no strap dimension.","anchors":{"top_center":[1225.8712042116981,0],"bottom_center":[1225.8712042116981,3634.4100000000003],"center":[1225.8712042116981,1817.2050000000002],"left_edge":[0,1817.2050000000002],"right_edge":[2451.7424084233962,1817.2050000000002],"epaulet_plain_right_center":[541.67,275.15],"epaulet_plain_left_center":[1910.17,274.8]},"landmarks":{"epaulet_plain_right":{"x":291.87,"y":187.3,"w":499.6,"h":175.7},"epaulet_plain_left":{"x":1660.27,"y":187.2,"w":499.8,"h":175.2}},"landmarks_note":"rects are {x,y,w,h} in user units (0.01 in)","overlay_of":"garment-blues-class-b-blouse-female-long","documented":["the shirt and blouse have epaulets for every member (CAPR 39-1 4.1.11.1.1 / 4.1.12.2)","shoulder cords are worn along the shoulder seam and, if the garment has an epaulet, underneath it (9.3, 9.4.1)","no grade goes on the strap itself: officers slip a gray or blue epaulet sleeve over it, NCOs and airmen wear chevrons or collar insignia"],"assumed":["strap size and shape (the traced base image does not draw it)","button size and position","topstitch inset"],"fit":{"method":"original","score":null},"grade":"accessory"}
